summary: Nora now knows every nickname the group uses for the people in a room, not only the nicknames of whoever is talking to her.
details: When someone asks about a member by a nickname («tell me when <nickname> joins voice»), she knows who is meant; before, a nickname used about someone else read as a stranger.
Only the people a room lists are included, never everyone Nora knows across other rooms.
limitations: A room open to everyone («persons = "*"») gets no such list yet, because it would need a live membership check on every message.
